svg.title: The Station's screen map: Home, the sections and the Vivarium's levels, from the whole down to one item. Structure only, 1×.
svg.text: The Station: Home, the sections and the Vivarium, from the whole down to one item (1×, structure only)
A section takes the whole stage; the frame (top bar, bottom line) stays on every screen but Idle. ✓ goes one level closer, ← one level out, and ← from a section's whole is Home.
with no top bar or bottom line
after 60 s, or ✓ Rest on Home
the same picture as the whole
the vivarium panel at the left: the residents, the with-you bed, the rest knob
the section column at the right: Cargo, Pods, Incubator, Probe, Library
on the room, ✓ does what needs you (the amber lamp, the notice)
✓ on the panel: the Vivarium, the whole · ✓ on a resident: that mibi up close
✓ on a module: that section's whole · ← nothing (Home is the top)
✓ Open the bay · Look at Bean
a key opens one section's whole from anywhere
follows this map and is decided separately
the Caddy's Dock is never a Station key
every mibi at home, full width
the with-you bed: the carried set
✓ a resident or a bay: up close
in the bay, sealed, up to three
pods to the rack, counters tick
the rack's pods, read by shape
one level: the bud in its chamber
the mibi up close, in the meet
one level: the Probe on its tray
the heart and skill notches on the card
one crate open at a time:
how far the land is explored
the report closes on any press
back to the bay, now empty
Visit Fig, a jump up close
the splice; Cross them: a jump
moves the ring inside this screen; never leaves it, never spends
one level closer, or the bottom line's action exactly as written
one level out, to the parent; the way back names it (88 px slot)
coloured: a section's whole, from anywhere; the set is decided separately
(teal, dotted) a ✓ that lands in another section; ← then follows the tree
the Caddy's key, never the Station's: the crates wait in Cargo; Home's
Cargo module lights amber and the notice names them
top bar and bottom line on Home, every section and every level;
Idle alone drops them. The title names the section, never the item.
Home · Vivarium · Cargo · Pods · Incubator · Probe · Library
Create · Cross · Sitting keep their own titles
a title carries the mark of the coloured key that leads there,
so the marks follow the key set
